places-big-solar-furnace-sairam-ugam-sta.story: From Parkent it runs 351 km to Parkent; allow about 6 h 03 of riding. On the way it passes Besh-Aral State Nature Reserve - main part, Sairam-Ugam State National Nature Park - S and back through Besh-Aral State Nature Reserve - main part. The highest point is about 2,700 m. It crosses Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
